summary: Refresh the effect-utils Nix and source-member pins to published revision 1e294f81aeec43c2e1f25ba25bb731c1c8336beb and remeasure the frozen TypeScript dependency installation.

replay.detail: No claim or replay behavior change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet coordination change.

compatibility.detail: Nix consumers must resolve effect-utils to the refreshed cohort. The existing installation narHash guard continues to reject mismatched consumer overrides before building. As a packaging workaround, installation outputs discard pacquet's leftover package.json_pacquet-stage_* files, whose PID/time/counter names made successful Darwin installations nondeterministic.

downtime.detail: The dependency pin refresh does not itself require a daemon restart.

manual.detail: Align consumer effect-utils inputs with revision 1e294f81aeec43c2e1f25ba25bb731c1c8336beb; refresh installation hashes using scripts/nix-typescript-client-deps-hash on supported systems.

recovery.detail: Revert the input pins and dependency installation pin together to restore the previous packaging cohort.
